degree_rationale: No man stands in agreement of joy until the end — even sun and moon do not rejoice wholly, because they see their enemy and the suffering soul. Treats the inward perception of cosmic incompleteness, the not-yet of joy.
direction_rationale: Inward affective reception of cosmic suffering — the eye's grief, the heart's not-rejoicing-wholly. Reflective sorrow under sight.
grand_man_function: Natural cosmic-grief reception — the heart's incompleteness while light is bound.
title: Two corruptions of the world and what is permanent within it
